regime_context: China A-shares detector shows narrow, fragile leadership: Banks rank #1 with score 1.015 and Pharmacies essentially tied at 0.998 (margin 0.017), with only 4 of 22 themes trend-eligible — a breadth fraction of 0.18, well below a healthy rotation. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and the tape mean-reverts, so the validated drawdown edge is absent; the detector offers no predictive edge here and my conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watch Medical Devices & TCM (512170.SS): it is crowded (crowding_z 1.00) yet ineligible and negatively ranked (#12, score -0.087). I am watching whether its score crosses above 0.5 AND it becomes trend-eligible within the next two weeks; that combination would retire the watch and confirm a crowding-driven leadership handoff from the current healthcare co-leader.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks carry the strongest composite: best durability_bar (0.73), broadest breadth (0.889), and trend-eligible (eligible=true). The absolute-trend gate is the one drawdown-control mechanism, and banks pass it where most themes fail. However crowding_z 1.78 (crowded=true) says leadership is fully-owned, and the whole-lot score (1.015) barely outpoints pharmacies (0.998) — this is a size-and-cap call, not an alpha call.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.78z with one_narrative=false and a coin-flip margin over challenger means flows can rotate away quickly on any policy headline; the trend gate did not cut drawdown on this market history, so passing it is not a validated edge here.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS posts negative 15-day relative return vs CSI 300 while its durability_bar falls below 0.50

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharmacies are the co-leader, statistically tied with banks (margin 0.017) and also trend-eligible with decent breadth (0.643). The rotation radar shows a confirmed near-handoff in progress, not a prediction — leadership is bifurcating between these two. Crowding_z 1.59 (crowded=true) is a cap caution, not a fade trigger.
theses.dissent: It is already crowded (1.59z) and the durability gap versus banks is real (0.60 vs 0.73); healthcare in A-shares historically whipsaws on policy and the rank-IC here is ~0, so this near-tie may just mean both are plateauing.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags 512800.SS by over 3% over a 10-day stretch while its breadth falls below 0.40

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is trend-eligible (eligible=true) but carries a 'mean-revert' hurst_tag, durability 0.46, and modest breadth 0.30 — the least healthy of the eligible four. With gate_helps=false on this mean-reverting tape, being eligible here does not confer drawdown protection, and coal lacks any momentum leadership (score 0.502, rank #6).
theses.dissent: Coal is one of only four eligible themes, so it is not broken trend-wise, and crowding_z is low (0.58, not crowded); an energy-policy or winter-demand shock could rescue it.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by over 2% over the next 15 days while its breadth expands above 0.50
